name: red-puntos
description: Plataforma de fidelización y puntos para una red de distribuidores (Ecuador)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-red-puntos --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-red-puntos --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node --test tests/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
